effects.label: Production: Bayes factor of the near-homogeneous Gricean (S1) model over the heterogeneous type model
effects.unit: participant (choice counts per participant and game)

outcome.scale: choice counts per participant, game and choice category
outcome.higherMeans: Bayes factor above 1 favours the near-homogeneous Gricean model

contrast.valueMeans: P(D | M_hom) / P(D | M_het); below 1 favours heterogeneity

prediction.text: the heterogeneity hypothesis expects a Bayes factor below 1 (data favour the heterogeneous model)

estimates.variant: tolerance e = 0.01 (exactly 99% Gricean S1 speakers), BF hom/het

missing: the e = 0.05 value (about 3.955, favouring the near-homogeneous model) is printed in a display equation that the PDF text layer renders as '3:955', so it is not transcribed
simulation error of the Bayes factor approximation

effects.notes: The JAGS hierarchical latent-type model and the Savage-Dickey approximation are not run by the package (not_ready).
